This document lists the Major Maintenance Procedures P1 for
 GIS Circuit Breaker 66 Kv type 8DN8 EGK and GIS Circuit Breaker 220kv type
 8DP3 Siemens, which must be performed every ten years bases as indicated by
 Y10 in the title block.

items: A work permit must be issued
CB must be fully isolated.
Control Power disconnected.

Grounding switch must be closed on both sides of CB to ensure it is properly
 grounded.

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing
 mask, safety glasses)

Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified or directly
 supervised by some one who is.

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work
 place.
Hydraulic trucks for each 220/66kv phase
Hand pump for hydraulic storage cylinder
Torque Wrench, Pressure Gauge.
Hydraulic oil, compete Set of Tools, Gas detector.
Emergency Light.
Dew point, Acidity and Air Content Equipment.
Paint and paint brushes, Bottle for oil sampling.

sections.text:
In case of the maintenance will be done on the 220kv circuit breaker, you
must inspect each phase of the CB individually because each phase are placed in
a separate compartment. (The 66kv CB phases are in one compartment).

items: Record number of make-break operation (as per operation counter or requested by system management).
Carry out visual check.
Record any special events (as requested by system management).
Check hydraulic operating system for external leakage (pipes, valves, etc.).
Check hydraulic operating system for internal leakage in on and off positions (pressure loss per hour at nominal pressure and with oil pump set switched off).
Check gas filling of main module using a precision pressure gauge.

Check readings of pressure gauges 45.129 (1-1510) for gas and 45.209 (1-1510) for pressurized oil at nominal pressure against
 readings of precision pressure gauge.

Check gas density monitor 45.135 (1-1510) using the service unit of the SF6 filling device A2
 {"Loss of SF6 "and "general lockout (SF6)"}.
Pump gas out of main module.

Gradually reduce oil pressure in hydraulic system to zero. Checking the operation of pressure monitors for lockouts 
 and signals. 
 -No.5 "General lockout (oil)"
 -No.6"Lockout (oil)"
 -No7"Oil delivery faulted".

Remove cover of manway opening 5.115(1-0410) in partition plate 5.105(1-0410) and prepare circuit-breaker module for
 withdrawa1.
Mount W345 truck assembly on circuit-breaker module.
Undo partition plates 5.105 (1-0410) and remove circuit-breaker module.
Clean all the poles including their operating rods (switching dust).

From an interrupter unit 5.261(1-0610) (remove fixed contact tube support 5.261.11 together with fixed contact tube 5.261.25 (1-0810) and check. In the ON start also inspect guide tube
 5.261.33 and the front end of blast cylinder 5.261.41 (10-810).

If
 any damage is found dismantle, inspect and if necessary repair the other two
 interrupter units as well.
Replace all three coupling contacts 5.269 (1-0510). Clean coupling contacts and contact pieces 437.7(1-0388) and grease sparingly.
Reinsert circuit-breaker module and bolt partition plate 5.105(1-0410) to the chamber of the main module.
Remove W345 truck assembly.

Reach through the manway opening 5.111(1-0410). Connect up tile flexible copper links 5.249.11 and 5.253.11(1-0510) and refit shielding plate
 36.75 of earthling switch 35.11 (1-0388).
Place new filter bags in box 5.119(1-0410) and fit cover 5.115(1-0410).

Connect
 hose of service unit to maintenance point 45.107 (1-1510) in automatic control unit of the circuit breaker, evacuate main module and fill with gas.

Check oil level in oil tank 5.27 (1-0410) (hydraulic operating system pressure less. Off
 state).

In this state check pipe couplings of hydraulic operating system retighten as necessary using a torque wrench
 see "General installation instructions".
Take oil sample frame bottom of tank 5.27 (1-0410) at oil drain plug 5.137.141.15 (1-1210) and examine (red and clear = good condition; opaque and milky state = poor condition Record result).
Drain oil from hydraulic operating system, clean oil tank and wash out filter 5.27.49 (1-1210).
Refill with new hydraulic oil.
Vent hydraulic operating system including oil pump.
Start oil pump set, 5.137.321, + 5.137.339. (1-1210) and check priming pressure of nitrogen filling in hydraulic storage cylinder 5.33 (1-0410) using a precision gauge.

If necessary replenish nitrogen filling in hydraulic storage cylinder 5.33
 (1-0410).

With rising and felling oil pressure check pressure monitors for correct operation (lockouts and signals): 
 -No.4"General lockout (N2)"
 - No.5"General lockout (oil)" 
 - No.6"Lockout (oil)"
 - No.7 Oil delivery faulted"
Check safety valve 45.249.11 (1-1510) (opening and closing pressure).

Replace position switch S2,
 part No 5.137 .303.9 (1-1210), of volume switch 5.137.303 on electric motor 5.137.321
 (1-1210)of the oil pump set.

Lightly oil sliding surfaces of mechanism parts between main valve 137.141 (1-1210) and auxiliary switch 137.369 (1-1210), and also
 On Off indicator 137.429 (1-1210). Check all mechanism parts.(Do not oil auxiliary switch.).
Check the closing magnets 137.51, and tripping magnets 137.69. (1-1210) of the control valve blocks: terminals, condition, aluminum ring (setscrew), magnets firmly tightened.
Check effect of electric heaters, e.g. 45.199 (1-1510), without carrying out measurement.
Check to see that all connections to terminals and contractors, etc .are tight.

Carry
 out Test Operations.

Test for correct functioning : 
 Operate breaker, check signals and lockouts, anti-pumping feature, On-Off indicators,etc. 
 (This test normally extends to the control room console)
Measure pressure of gas filling (final check).
Check all remade joints (covers and flanges) for any signs of leakage. (Final check).
Check oil level in tank (final check).
Check hydraulic operating system for external leakage (final check).
Secure pressure release valve 45.249.17 (1-1510) (final check).
Measure moisture air contact of the gas (final check).
Measure air contact of the gas (final check).
Paint finish and anti-corrosion protection to be touched up by customer's personnel.

 at 303 bar.

Introduction

 supervised by some one who is.
